text: Raja Sejong wantah raja kaping pat saking Dinasti Joseon tur wantah sane pinih kapandang.
eng_text: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Ipun ring pangawitne ngaranin aksara Hangeul sakadi Hunmin Jeongeum, sane maarti "suara sane patut mantuka ring nitahang anak."
eng_text: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Wenten akeh teori antuk sapunapi mawinan Sanskerta kawentenang. Silih sinunggil wantan indik migrasi krama Arya saking kauh ka India sane makta basa ipune.
eng_text: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Sanskerta wantah basa kuna tur wantah polih kasaihan ring basa Latin sane kaangge ring Eropa.
eng_text: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Buku sane kauningin pinih riin ring gumine wantah kasurat ring basa Sanskerta. Sasampun pupulan Upanisad, Sanskerta wantah ngancan kamur duaning kasta.
eng_text: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Sanskerta wantah basa sane dahat kompleks lan sugih, sane mawinan dados sumber mantuka ring akeh basa India modern, tuah sakadi Latin sane dados sumber basa Eropa minakadi Prancis lan Spanyol.
eng_text: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Sasampune pasiat Prancis wusan, Jerman ngawit sayaga antuk ngrejek pulau Inggris.
eng_text: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Jerman ngawastanin pangrejek punika antuk kode "Operasi Singa Laut". Kakehan sanjata abot miwah suplai tentara Inggris sampun ical sasampune kapindahang saking Dunkirk, manawi tentarane dados enduk pisan.
eng_text: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Nanging Angkatan Laut Kerajaan wantah kantun doh sitengan katimbang ring Angkatan Laut Jerman ("Kriegsmarine") tur prasida menyahang sakancang pasukan pangrejek sane kakirim ngalintangin Kanal Inggris.
eng_text: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Nanging, tuah akidik kapal Angkatan Laut Kerajaan sane mapangkalan nampek rute pangrejek sawireh sang laksamana jejeh ipun pacang kakelemang olih pangrejek udara Jermane.
eng_text: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Ngiring kawitin antuk penjelasan indik rencana Italia. Italia wantah utamanyane "arin" Jerman miwah Jepang.
eng_text: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Punika madue tentara sane endukan miwah angkatan laut sane endukan, yadiastun ipun wawu pisan ngewangun papat kapal anyar duk sadurung pangawit perange.
eng_text: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Tetujon utama Italia wantah negara-negara Afrika. Mantuka ring ngejuk negara-negara punika, ipun patut madue landasan paluncuran pasukan, manawi para pasukan polih malayar nyebrangin Segara Mediterania tur ngrejek Afrika.
eng_text: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Antuk tetujon punika, ipun patut ngicalang pangkalan miwah kapal-kapal Inggris ring Mesir. Saluiran ring aksi-aksi punika, kapal perang Italia nenten kaicen tugas antuk malaksana sane lianan.
eng_text: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Mangkin antuk Jepang. Jepang wantah negara pulau, taler sakadi Inggris.
eng_text: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Kapal selam inggih punika kapal-kapal sane karancang antuk mamargi ring sor segarane, tur meneng irika ring galah sane sue.
eng_text: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Kapal selam kaanggen ring Perang Dunia I miwah Perang Dunia II. Rikala punika kapale wantah banban pisan tur madue jarak tembak sane mawates pisan.
eng_text: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Ring pangawit perange kapal punika kakehan mamargi ring duur segarane, nanging sasampune radar ngawit kakembangang tur dados ngancan akurat kapal selam kapaksa antuk nyilem ring sor toya segarane mantuka ring nenten kacingak.
eng_text: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Kapal selam Jerman kabaos U-Boats. Krama Jerman wantah waged ring navigasi tur ngamargiang kapal selam ipune.
eng_text: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Duaning kasuksesan ipun ring kapal selam, sasampun perang Jerman nenten kapercayain antuk nuenang akeh kapal selam.
eng_text: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Nggih! Raja Tutankhamun, ri kenkene kabaos sakadi "Raja Tut" utawi "Raja Alit", wantah silih sinunggil raja Mesir kuna sane pinih subaga ring galah modern.
eng_text: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Sane menarik, ipun wantah nenten kaanggap dahat padgata ring galah sane riin tur nenten kacutet ring daptar raja pinih kuna.
eng_text: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Nanging, panemuan kuburan ipun ring 1922 ngardi ipun dados selebriti. Risedek akeh kuburan saking galah riin karampok, kuburan ipun das nenten katundik.
eng_text: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Kaakehan barang sane kapendem sareng Tutankhamun wantah becik kasimpen, rumasuk siuan artifak sane malakar antuk metal sane madue pangarga miwah batu-batu langka.
eng_text: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Panemuan peleg jari-jari ngranayang kereta Assyria iingan, becatan, tur becikan kasayagayang antuk miwalin pasukan miwah kereta lianan.
eng_text: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Panah saking busur silang ipune polih nanceb ring baju besi tentara musuh. Sawatara 1000 B.C, krama Assyria ngenalang kavaleri kapertama.
eng_text: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Kavaleri wantah tentara sane masiat saking duur jarane. Sadelne durung katemuang, manawi kavaleri Assyria masiat saking duur tundun jarane sane malalung.
eng_text: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Iraga uning sapunapi akehnyane politikus Yunani, ilmuwan, miwah artis. Minab anak sane pinih kasub ring budaya puniki wantah Homer, pangawi puisi legenda sane buta, sane ngawi kalih kakawian agung antuk sastra Yunani: puisi Illiad lan Odyssey.
eng_text: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Sophocles miwah Aristophanes wantah kantun dramawan populer tur drama ipune kapanggih ring karya-karya agung dunia sastra.
eng_text: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Anak Yunani sane subaga lianan wantah ilmuwan Matematika Pythagoras, akeh kauningin antuk teori ipune sane kasub indik paiketan sisin-sisin segitiga siku-siku.
eng_text: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Wenten magenepan taksiran antuk akuda akehnnyane anak sane mabasa Hindi. Punika kataksir wantah dados basa kaping kalih napike kaping pat sane kaanggen ring jagate.
eng_text: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Akehnyane pawicara asli malianan manut ring napike dialek sane dahat nampek mapaiketan taler kapetekin.
eng_text: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Embang sane kataksir wantah saking 340 yuta ngantos 500 yuta pawicara, tur saakehne 800 yuta anak polih ngaresepang basane punika.
eng_text: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Hindi miwah Urdu wantah mirip ring kosabasa ipune nanging mabinayan ring sasuratan; ring pabligbagan sarahina-rahina, para pawicara antuk makakalih basa biasane polih ngertinin raga soang-soang.
eng_text: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Sawatara ring abad ka 15, Estonia Kaja wantah ring plalah budaya ageng saking Jerman.
eng_text: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Makudang-kudang biarawan Jerman mapikayun antuk makta Widhin ipun nyansan nampek ring para krama asli, manawi ipun ngawi basa literal Estonia.
eng_text: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Punika kadasarin antuk alfabet Jerman miwah asiki aksara "Õ/õ" wantah kaimbuhang.
eng_text: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Rikala galah mamargi, akeh kruna sane kasilih saking basa Jerman mapadu. Puniki wantah pangawit kawentenan galah pencerahan.
eng_text: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Secara tradisional, pawaris antuk tahta punika jagi raris ngranjing ring militer sasampun sekolah ipun wusan.
eng_text: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Nanging, Charler ngranjing ka universitas ring Trinity College, Cambridge ring dija ipun malajahin Antropologi miwah Arkeologi, tur raris ring Sejarah, ngamolihang 2:2 (gelar ring soran kelas kaping kalih).
eng_text: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles wantah angga kapertama saking Kulawarga Kerajaan Inggris sane ngamolihang gelar.
eng_text: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Turki Eropa (Trace kangin wiadin Rumelia ring semenanjung Balkan nyakup 3% wewidangan negarane.
eng_text: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Wewidangan Turki wantah akehan saking 1.600 kilometer (1.000 mi) panjangne tur 800 km (500 mi) linggahne, marupa wentuk segipat panjang.
eng_text: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Wewidangan Turki, nyakup danu-danu, wantah 783.562 kilometer persegi ring dija 755.688 kilometer persegi (291.773 mi persegi) wantah ring wewidangan Asia kelod kauh miwah 23.764 kilometer persegi (9.174 mi persegi) ring Eropa.
eng_text: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Wewidangan Turki punika ngardi panegarane dados nomer 37 pinih linggah ring jagate, tur wantah kirang langkung akuruan Prancis Metropolitan miwah Inggris kapaduang.
eng_text: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Turki wantah kailehin olih segara ring tigang sisi: Segara Aegea ring sisi kauh, Segara Selem ring sisi kaja miwah Segara Mediterania ring sisi kelod.
eng_text: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Luksemburg madue sejarah sane lantang nanging tanggal kemerdekaannyane saking warsa 1839.
eng_text: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Bagian masa-masa Belgia sane  mangkin wantah bagian saking Luksemburg ring i pidan nanging dados Belgia sesampunyane wenten Revolusi Belgia duk 1830-an.
eng_text: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Luksemburg sering ngutsahayang mangda tetep dados negara sane netral nanging kalinggihang ring Perang Dunia 1 lan Perang Dunia 2 olih Jerman.
eng_text: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Duk warsa 1957 Luksemburg dados anggota pendiri organisasi sane mangkin kauningin mawasta Uni Eropa.
eng_text: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Dzong Drukgyal wantah benteng sane uwug lan biara Buddha ring baduur kabupaten Paro (ring Desa Phondey).
eng_text: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Kabaosang yening ring warsa 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel ngardiang benteng sane  kaanggen memperingati kemenangan ipun antuk pasukan Tibet-Mongol.
eng_text: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Duk warsa 1951, api ngawinang wantah makudang-kudang peninggalan Dzong Drukgyal sane masisa, sakadi gambar Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
eng_text: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Usan kebakaran punika, benteng ipun kalestariang lan kalindungin, tetep dados silih sinunggil genah patiwisata ring Bhutan sane paling sensasional.
eng_text: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Duk abad ke-18 Kamboja nemu ipun sedeng ring makakalih negara sane mapisaga lan kuat, Thailand lan Vietnam.
eng_text: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Jatma Thailand nyerbu Kamboja makudang-kudang kaping ring abad ke 18 lan ring warsa 1772 ipun nguwugang Phnom Phen.
eng_text: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Duk warsane sane dados pamuput warsa ring abad ke -18 Vietnam turmaning nginvasi Kamboja.
eng_text: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: 18% Venezuela wantah nganggur, lan akehan saking ipun sane makarya ring perekonomian informal.
eng_text: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Kalih per tiga saking Venezuela makarya ring sektor jasa, seperempat pakaryan ring industri, lan sane kalima ring bidang pertanian.
eng_text: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Industri sane sarat ring Venezuela wantah minyak, genah negara ipun ngamargiang eksportir sane bersih, yadiastun wantah siki persen pakaryan ring industri minyak.
eng_text: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Ring pangungkur kemerdekaan bangsa, Taman Botanic Singapura ngawinang ipun magentos dados bencingah taman tropis.
eng_text: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Duk warsa 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, anggrek hibrida, kapilih dados bunga nasional bangsa.
eng_text: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Tiap warsa ring Oktober kirang langkung 1.5 yuta herbivora mamargi ke dataran kelod, nyebrangin Tukad Mara, saking bukit kaja ulian hujan.
eng_text: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Laut mewali ngajanang ngentasin kauh, malih apisan ngentasin Tukad Mara, sesampun ujan ring bulan april.
eng_text: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Wilayah Serengeti madaging Taman Nasional Serengeti, Area Konservasi Ngorongoro lan Cadangan Game Maswa ring Tanzania lan Cagar Nasional Maasai Mara ring Kenya.
eng_text: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Melajah makarya media interaktif merluang keterampilan konvensional lan tradisional, turmaning alat sane kakuasain ring kelas interaktif (storyboarding, editing audio lan video, masatua, miwah sane lianan).
eng_text: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Desain interaktif ngematutang ida dane menikai malih asumsi ida dane antuk produksi media lan melajah mapineh nganggen cara sane nenten linear.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Desain interaktif ngematutang komponen proyek mangda terhubung asiki lan sane lianan, nanging mangda masuk akal dados entitas sane mepalasan malih.
eng_text: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Kerugian saking lensa pembesar wantah kompleksitas fokusnyane lan jumlah elemen lensa sane kaperluang antuk manggihin sekancan jarak fokus antuk objek sane joh mangda agengan teken lensa utama.
eng_text: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Puniki prasida ngirangin masalah krana produsen lensa manggihin standar sane tegehan ring produksi lensa punika.
eng_text: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Puniki sampun prasida ngaryanin lensa pembesar antuk ngasilang gambar makualitas sane sida kabandingang sareng lensa sane madue jarak fokus tetap.
eng_text: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Kerugian tiosan saking lensa pembesar sakadi puniki wantah kecepatan maksimum lensa umumnyane betenan.
eng_text: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Puniki ngawinang lensa pembesar sane mudah keweh kaanggen ring kondisi sunar sane nduk tanpa wantuan sunar flash
eng_text: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Silih sinunggil pikobet pinih lumrah rikala ngutsahayang mangonversi film ka format DVD inggih punika overscan.
eng_text: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Kaakehan tipi kakaryanin dados pamargi antuk nyenengin krama lumrah.
eng_text: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Mawinan dadalan punika, makasami sane kacingak ring TV madue wates sane kagetep, baduur, sor, miwah samping.
eng_text: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Indike puniki kalaksanayang antuk ngayaktinin wantah gambar punika nekepin makasami layar. Punika kabaos overscan.
eng_text: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Sayangne, rikala ida dane ngaryanin DVD, watesne manawita taler pacang kapotong, tur yening video punika madue subtitle bas nampek ring sor, punika nenten pacang kasinahang makasami.
eng_text: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Kastil abad pertengahan tradisional sampun sue ngilhamin imajinasi, nyulapin gambar joust, jamuan ajengan miwah satriya Arthurian.
eng_text: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Jawat ngadeg ring pantaraning rentehan mayusa siuan warsa, elah antuk ngelingang suara lan bo jurit sane sampun sue pidan, antuk das mirengin derap batis ring margi mabatu miwah antuk ngendusin rasa jerih sane matampak ring clegokan bui beten tanah.
eng_text: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Nanging napikeh pepineh iraga kadasarin antuk biakta? Napi mawinan karaton kawangun simalu? Sapunapi karaton punika ngarancang lan ngawangun?
eng_text: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Khas antuk periode punika, Kirby Muxloe Castle lebih saking umah sane kabentengin tekening kastil sane sujati.
eng_text: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Jendela-jendela ageng sane mengkilap lan dinding tipis nenten prasida nahenang serangan sane sampun jagi kamargiang saking ilu.
eng_text: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Duk warsa 1480-an, dugas konstruksinyane kajumuin olih Lord Hastings, negara punika relatif damai lan pertahanan wantah kaperluang ring sekaa alit saking perampok roving.
eng_text: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Keseimbangan kekuasaan wantah sistem genah negara-negara Eropa mautsaha nahenang kedaulatan nasional saking makasamian negara-negara Eropa.
eng_text: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Konsepnyane wantah samian negara Eropa patut mautsaha nyegah asiki bangsa mangda kuat, lan santukan asapunika pemerintah nasional pepes ngentos aliansi ipun mangda ngejaga keseimbangan.
eng_text: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Perang suksesi Spanyol nandain perang kapertama sane pusat masalahnyane wantah keseimbangan kekuasaan.
eng_text: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Puniki nandain gentos sane sarat, santukan kekuatan Eropa nenten malih madue dalih saking dados perang agama. Santukan asapunika, perang telung dasa warsa jagi dados perang pamuput mangda kaicenin label perang agana.
eng_text: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Kuil Artemis ring Efesus kahancurang ring 21 Juli 356 SM krana tindakan pamuun sane kamargiang olih Herostratus.
eng_text: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Manurut critanyane, motivasinyane wantah ketenaran antuk prabia ipun. Efesus, kroda, ngumumang wantah parab Herostratus sane nenten naen kacatet.
eng_text: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Sejarawan Yunani Strabo sesampunyane parab punika kacatet, santukan punika sane kauningin mangkin. Kuil punika lebar ring wengi sane  pateh teken Alexander The Great lekad.
eng_text: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Alexander, dados raja, nawahin antuk naurin anggen ngewangun malih kuil punika, nanging tawaran punika katolak. Usan punika, sesampune Alexander padem, kuil punika kawangun malih ring 323 SM.
eng_text: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Elingang tangan ida dane rileks sambilang tetep nyingakin catetan sami sane beneh lan nyoba mangda nenten nganargiang gerakan sane asing nganggen jerijin ida dane.
