text: Wenten variasi sane nenten mewates sane polih kalaksanayang, nanging puniki kantun napi sane kapinehang olih kakehan jadma rikala ipun maosang indik "melali ka Disney World".
eng_text: There are infinite variations possible, but this remains what most people mean when they talk of "going to Disney World".

text: Akeh tiket sane kaadol online ring situs web lelang minakadi eBay utawi Craigslist makudang-kudang ngangge tiket multi-day park-hopper.
eng_text: Many tickets sold online through auction websites such as eBay or Craigslist are partially used multi-day park-hopper tickets.

text: Risedek puniki wantah aktivitas sane sanget biasa, banget kalarang olih Disney: tiket nenten polih kapindahtanganang.
eng_text: While this is a very common activity, it is prohibited by Disney: the tickets are non-transferable.

text: Sabilang makemah ring sor sisin Grand Canyon nyaratang ijin padalaman.
eng_text: Any camping below the rim in Grand Canyon requires a backcountry permit.

text: Ijin kawatesin antuk ngabihin ngarai punika, lan kawentenang ring rahina kapertama sabilang sasih, petang sasih sadurung sasih pangawit.
eng_text: Permits are limited to protect the canyon, and become available on the 1st day of the month, four months prior to the start month.

text: Antuk asapunika, ijin pedalaman antuk ngawit pinanggal napi ja ring sasih Mei pacang kawentenang ring 1 Januari.
eng_text: Thus, a backcountry permit for any start date in May becomes available on 1 Jan.

text: Genah antuk wewidangan pinih kasub, sakadi Bright Angel Campground sane mapaekan sareng Phantom Ranch, lumrahne kabekin olih pinunasan sane katerima ring pinanggal pertama reservasi mabuka.
eng_text: Space for the most popular areas, such as the Bright Angel Campground adjacent to Phantom Ranch, generally fill up by the requests received on first date they are opened to reservations.

text: Wenten agebog ijin mawates sane kawentenang antuk pinunasan langsung sane kawentenang madasar antuk sira sane rauh kapertama, kalayanin pertama.
eng_text: There are a limited number permits reserved for walk-in requests available on a first come, first served basis.

text: Ngranjing ring Afrika Kelod ngangge mobil wantah cara sane ngangobin antuk nyingakin sami kaluwihan wewidangane punika tur taler angge mamargi ka genah-genah saking rute wisata biasa.
eng_text: Entering Southern Africa by car is an amazing way to see all the region's beauty as well as to get to places off the normal tourist routes.

text: Puniki polih kalaksanayang ring mobil biasa ngangge parencanaan sane cepil nanging 4x4 sanget kasaranang tur akeh genah wantah prasida kangranjingin ngangge mobil 4x4 maroda tegeh.
eng_text: This can be done in a normal car with careful planning but a 4x4 is highly advised and many locations are only accessible with a high wheel base 4x4.

text: Patut kaelingang rikala madue rencana yadiastun Afrika Kelod stabil nenten sami negara tetangga sakadi punika.
eng_text: Keep in mind while planning that although Southern Africa is stable not all neighboring countries are.

text: Prasyarat visa lan bea mabinayang saking negara siki ka negara lianan tur kapengaruhin olih negara genah ida dane measal.
eng_text: Visa requirements and costs vary from nation to nation and are affected by the country you come from.

text: Sabilang negara taler madue hukum pininget mlelenin barang darurat sane kaperluang ring mobile.
eng_text: Each country also has unique laws requiring what emergency items need to be in the car.

text: Victoria Falls inggih punika kota ring wewidangan kauh Zimbabwe, nyebrangin wates saking Livingston, Zambia, tur nampek Botswana.
eng_text: Victoria Falls is a town in the western portion of Zimbabwe, across the border from Livingstone, Zambia, and near Botswana.

text: Kota punika magenah ring sisin yeh terjun, tur punika dados atraksi utama, nanging genah tetujon turis populer puniki ngaturang pengunjung sane ngerereh petualangan lan pelancong makudang-kudang kesempatan meneng suean.
eng_text: The town lies immediately next to the falls, and they are the major attraction, but this popular tourist destination offers both adventure seekers and sightseers plenty of opportunities for a longer stay.

text: Ring musim sabeh (November ngantos Maret), akeh toyane pacang dados tegehan tur yeh terjun puniki ngancan dramatis.
eng_text: In the rainy season (November to March), the water volume will be higher and the Falls will be more dramatic.

text: Ida dane kapastikayang pacang belus yening ngelintangin jembatan utawi mamargi ring salantang margi setapak nampek ring yeh terjune punika.
eng_text: You are guaranteed to get wet if you cross the bridge or walk along the trails winding near the Falls.

text: Ring sisi lianan, wantah duaning volume toyane tegeh sakadi punika ngranayang pemandangan ida dane antuk yeh terjune pacang kasaruang - olih makasami toya!
eng_text: On the other hand, it is precisely because the volume of water is so high that your viewing of the actual Falls will be obscured—by all the water!

text: Makam Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 minab dados makam sane pinih kasub ring lembah, genah panemuan Howard Carter warsa 1922 antuk kuburan kerajaan raja muda sane das tileh.
eng_text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62). KV62 may be the most famous of the tombs in the Valley, the scene of Howard Carter's 1922 discovery of the almost intact royal burial of the young king.

text: Kabandingan teken kakehan kuburan kerajaan lianan, yadiastun kenten, makam Tutankhamun das nyalah kakunjungin, kerana doh alitan tur hiasan ipun sane akidik.
eng_text: Compared to most of the other royal tombs, however, the tomb of Tutankhamun is barely worth visiting, being much smaller and with limited decoration.

text: Sapasira sane seneng antuk nyingakin bukti kausakan mumi sane kalaksanayang selami utsahanyane kaangkat saking peti mati pacang kuciwa sawireh tuah sirah lan palan ipun sane prasida kacingak.
eng_text: Anyone interested in seeing evidence of the damage to the mummy done during attempts to remove it from the coffin will be disappointed as only the head and shoulders are visible.

text: Kasugihan makam sane banget pisan nenten malih wenten ring tengah ipun, nanging sampun kapindahang ka Musium Mesir ring Kairo.
eng_text: The fabulous riches of the tomb are no longer in it, but have been removed to the Egyptian Museum in Cairo.

text: Pengunjung antuk galah sane abos-bos pinih becik nelasan galah ipun ring genah lianan.
eng_text: Visitors with limited time would be best to spend their time elsewhere.

text: Phnom Krom, 12 km kelod kauh Siem Reap. Kuil pucak bukit puniki wantah kawangun ring pamuput abad ke-9, selami pemerintahan Raja Yasovarman.
eng_text: Phnom Krom, 12 km southwest of Siem Reap. This hilltop temple was built at the end of the 9th century, during the reign of King Yasovarman.

text: Atmosfir surem miwah pemandangan Danu Tonle Sap ngawinang mendaki bukit puniki wantah mapangarga.
eng_text: The gloomy atmosphere of the temple and the view over the Tonle Sap lake make the climb to the hill worthwhile.

text: Kunjungan ring genah puniki polih elah kaadukang sareng pamargi maperau ka danu.
eng_text: A visit to the site can be conveniently combined with a boat trip to the lake.

text: Angkor Pass kasaratang anggen ngeranjing ka kuil kerana punika sampunang lali makta paspor ida danene rikala nuju Tonle Sap.
eng_text: The Angkor Pass is needed to enter the temple so do not forget to bring your passport along when heading to Tonle Sap.

text: Yerusalem wantah ibukota lan kota pinih ageng ring Israel, yadiastun kakehan negara lianan lan PBB nenten ngakuin ipun dados ibukota Israel.
eng_text: Jerusalem is the capital and largest city of Israel, though most other countries and the United Nations do not recognize it as Israel's capital.

text: Kota kuna ring Bukit Yudea madue sejarah sane menarik mayusa siuan warsa.
eng_text: The ancient city in the Judean Hills has a fascinating history spanning thousands of years.

text: Kota puniki wantah suci marep ring tiga agama monoteistik - Yudaisme, Kristen lan Islam, sane madue kawigunan dados pusat spiritual, agama, lan budaya.
eng_text: The city is holy to the three monotheistic religions - Judaism, Christianity and Islam, and serves as a spiritual, religious, and cultural center.

text: Duaning kapadgatan agama antuk kota puniki, tur khususne akeh genah ipun ring wewidangan Kota Tua, Yerusalem wantah silih sinunggil antuk akeh genah tetujon wisata ring Israel.
eng_text: Due to the religious significance of the city, and in particular the many sites of the Old City area, Jerusalem is one of the main tourist destinations in Israel.

text: Yerusalem madue akeh genah masejarah, arkeologis lan mabudaya, kasarengin antuk pusat mablanja sane rame tur aktif, kafe, lan restoran.
eng_text: Jerusalem has many historic, archeological and cultural sites, along with vibrant and crowded shopping centers, cafés, and restaurants.

text: Ekuador ngicen prasyarat wantah warga negara Kuba nerima surat undangan sadurunge ngeranjing ring Ekuador ngalintangin bandara internasional utawi titik penerimaan perwatesan.
eng_text: Ecuador requires that Cuban citizens receive an invitation letter prior to entering Ecuador through international airports or frontier admission points.

text: Surat puniki patut kasahang olih Kementrian Luar Negeri Ekuador, tur nganutin prasyarat sane janten.
eng_text: This letter must be legalized by the Ecuadorian Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and comply with certain requirements.

text: Prasyarat puniki karancang mantuka ngaryanang aliran migrasi terorganisir ring embang makekalih negara.
eng_text: These requirements are designed to provide an organized migratory flow between both countries.

text: Warga negara Kuba sane ngamel kartu gadang patut ngunjungin Konsulat Ekuador antuk ngarereh pangecualian saking prasyarat puniki.
eng_text: Cuban citizens who are US green card holders should visit an Ecuadorian Consulate to obtain an exemption to this requirement.

text: Paspor ida danene sapatutne berlaku sakirangne 6 sasih sasampun pinanggal pamargin ida danene. Tiket pamargi bolak-balik/nuju genah salanturnyane kasaratang anggen muktiang lantang galah meneng ida dane.
eng_text: Your passport must be valid for at least 6 months beyond your travel dates. A round/onward trip ticket is needed to prove the length of your stay.

text: Tur mudahan ring kelompok akehan, kerana punika yening ida dane wantah peraragan utawi wantah kasarengin sawitra adiri, utsahayang ngarereh anak lianan lan karyanang grup antuk pat ngantos nem mantuka ngarereh pangarga per anak sane mudahan.
eng_text: Tours are cheaper for larger groups, so if you're by yourself or with just one friend, try to meet other people and form a group of four to six for a better per-person rate.

text: Nanging, puniki sapatutnyane nenten seken-seken dados kajejehan ida dane, kerana pepes turis kaadukan mantuka ngenepin mobil.
eng_text: However, this shouldn't really be off your concern, because often tourists are shuffled around to fill the cars.

text: Minab sujatine lewih dados cara nipu anak mangdane percaya wantah ipun patut mayah akehan.
eng_text: It seems actually to be more a way of tricking people into believing they have to pay more.

text: Ngayor ring pucak baduur kaja ring Machu Picchu wantah gunung sane cepung puniki, sesai dados latar akeh poto antuk reruntuhannyane.
eng_text: Towering above the north end of Machu Picchu is this steep mountain, often the backdrop to many photos of the ruins.

text: Sinah ngae jerih akidik saking sor, tur punika dados pendakian sane cepung tur sukeh, nanging anak sane sujatine siteng pacang prasida muputang ring sawatara 45 menit.
eng_text: It looks a bit daunting from below, and it is a steep and difficult ascent, but most reasonably fit persons should be able to make it in about 45 minutes.

text: Undag-undag batu kagenahang ring salantang kakehan jalur, tur ring bagian-bagian sane cepungan kabel baja kasayagayang kaanggen genah magisian.
eng_text: Stone steps are laid along most of the path, and in the steeper sections steel cables provide a supporting handrail.

text: Punika kabaos, sayaga antuk telas angkihane, tur tragia ring bagian sane cepungan, utamanya rikala belus, sawireh gelis dados madurgama.
eng_text: That said, expect to be out of breath, and take care in the steeper portions, especially when wet, as it can become dangerous quickly.

text: Wenten asiki gua sane alit das ring pucak sane patut kalintangin, kawentenannyane sedeng cupit lan andap.
eng_text: There's a tiny cave near the top that must be passed through, it is quite low and a rather tight squeeze.

text: Nyingakin situs lan margasatwa Galapagos pinih becik ngangge prau, pateh sakadi sane kalaksanayang olih Charles Darwin ring warsa 1835.
eng_text: Seeing the sites and wildlife of the Galapagos is best done by boat, just as Charles Darwin did it in 1835.

text: Akeh saking 60 kapal pesiar ngarungin toya Galapagos - ngawit saking ukuran antuk 8 ngantos 100 penumpang.
eng_text: Over 60 cruise ships ply the Galapagos waters - ranging in size from 8 to 100 passengers.

text: Kakehan krama mesen genah ipun dumunan (kerana prau-prau pepes bek rikala musim rame)
eng_text: Most people book their place well in advance (as the boats are usually full during the high season).

text: Jantenang agen genah ida dane mesen wantah spesalis Galapagos tur madue wawasan sane becik indik mabinayan kapal.
eng_text: Be sure the agent through whom you book is a Galapagos specialist with a good knowledge of a wide variety of ships.

text: Puniki pacang mastikayang katertarikan khusus miwah/utawi keleluasaan manut ring kapal sane pinih cocok.
eng_text: This will ensure that your particular interests and/or constraints are matched with the ship most suitable to them.

text: Sadurung krama Spanyol rauh ring abad ka-16, Chili Kaja wantah kapranata olih Inca risedek suku asli Araucanian (Mapuche) meneng ring Chili Tengah lan Kelod.
eng_text: Before the Spanish arrived in the 16th century, northern Chile was under Inca rule while the indigenous Araucanians (Mapuche) inhabited central and southern Chile.

text: Anak Mapuche taler wantah silih sinunggil kelompok asli terakhir sane merdeka, sane ten sepenuhne ngangge aturan mabasa Spanyol ngantos kemerdekaan Chili.
eng_text: The Mapuche were also one of the last independent American indigenous groups, that were not fully absorbed into Spanish-speaking rule until after Chile's independence.

text: Yadiastun Chili nyambatang kemerdekaan ipun ring warsa 1810 (ring tengah pasiat Napoleon sane ninggalin Spanyol tanpa pemerintahan pusat mawiguna selami makudang warsa), jayanthi sane nentuang antuk warga Spanyol nenten karereh ngantos 1818.
eng_text: Although Chile declared independence in 1810 (amid the Napoleonic wars that left Spain without a functioning central government for a couple of years), decisive victory over the Spanish was not achieved until 1818.

text: Republik Dominika (Spanyol: Republica Dominicana) inggih punika negara Karibia sane ngungsi genah atenga ring sisi kangin pulau Hispaniola, madum sareng Haiti.
eng_text: The Dominican Republic (Spanish: República Dominicana) is a Caribbean country that occupies the eastern half of the island of Hispaniola, which it shares with Haiti

text: Saliyanan ring pasisi mabias putih miwah pemandangan gunung, negara puniki wantah genah antuk kota Eropa kuna ring Amerika, sane mangkin dados kepahan Santo Domingo.
eng_text: Besides white sand beaches and mountain landscapes, the country is home to the oldest European city in the Americas, now part of Santo Domingo.

text: Pulo puniki pertama pisan katongosin oleh krama Taionos miwah Karibia. Krama Karibia wantah anak mabasa Arawak sane sampun rauh irika ring sawatara 10.000 SM.
eng_text: The island was first inhabited by the Taínos and Caribes. The Caribes were an Arawakan-speaking people who had arrived around 10,000 BCE.

text: Ring makudang-kudang warsa sane bawak sasampun pangrauh penjelajah Eropa, cacah jiwa Tainos sampun kakirangin signifikan olih para panakluk Spanyol.
eng_text: Within a few short years following the arrival of European explorers, the population of Tainos had significantly been reduced by the Spanish conquerors

text: Madasar antuk Fray Bartolome de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) ring embang galah 1492 miwah 1498, para panakluk Spanyol ngamademang sawatara 100.000 Tainos.
eng_text: Based on Fray Bartolomé de las Casas (Tratado de las Indias) between 1492 and 1498 the Spanish conquerors killed around 100,000 Taínos.

text: Jardin de la Union. Ruang puniki kawangun dados atrium antuk biara abad ka-17, ring dija Templo de San Diego wantah tuah asiki wangunan sane kantun mawiguna.
eng_text: Jardín de la Unión. This space was built as the atrium for a 17th-century convent, of which the Templo de San Diego is the sole surviving building.

text: Mangkin kaangge ados alun-alun tengah, tur sesai wenten akeh sane kalangsungang, lemah lan peteng.
eng_text: It now functions as the central plaza, and always has a lot of things going on, day and night.

text: Wenten makudang restoran nampek ring taman, tur ring sanja lan wengi irika konser gratis pepes kawentenang saking gazebo pusat.
eng_text: There are a number of restaurants surrounding the garden, and in the afternoons and evening there free concerts are often given from the central gazebo.

text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Kalih balkon kapisahang tuah sadoh 69 sentimeter wantah umah antuk satua tresna sane kuna.
eng_text: Callejon del Beso (Alley of the Kiss). Two balconies separated by only 69 centimeters is home of an old love legend.

text: Antuk naur makudang jinah, makudang anak alit pacang nyaritayang satuane punika ring ida dane.
eng_text: For a few pennies some children will tell you the story.

text: Pulau Bowen wantah pamargi populer arahina utawi liburan pamuput wuku sane ngaturang menek kayak, mendaki, toko-toko, restoran, muah akeh malih.
eng_text: Bowen Island is a popular day trip or weekend excursion offering kayaking, hiking, shops, restaurants, and more.

text: Komunitas asli puniki magenah ring Howe Sound tuah nampek Vancouver, tur elah karereh liwat taksi air majadwal sane mamargi saking Pulai Granville ring pusat kota Vancouver.
eng_text: This authentic community is located in Howe Sound just off Vancouver, and is easily accessed via scheduled water taxis departing Granville Island in downtown Vancouver.

text: Ring ida dane sane seneng ring kegiatan ring jaba, pamargi munggah ring koridor Sea to Sky wantah padgata.
eng_text: For those who enjoy outdoor activities, a trek up the Sea to Sky corridor is essential.

text: Bakungan Whistler (1,5 jam mamargi saking Vancouver) mael nanging subaga mawinan Olimpiade Musim Dingin 2010.
eng_text: Whistler (1.5 hour drive from Vancouver) is expensive but well-known because of the 2010 Winter Olympics.

text: Ring musim dingin, durus rasayang makudang genah ski pinih becik ring Amerika Kaja, tur ring musim panes cuba masepeda gunung sane asli.
eng_text: In the winter, enjoy some of the best skiing in North America, and in the summer try some authentic mountain biking.

text: Ijin patut karereh sadurungne. Ida dane patut madue ijin yening nginep ring Sirena.
eng_text: Permits must be reserved in advance. You must have a permit to stay overnight at Sirena.

text: Sirena wantah tuah asiki stasiun ranger sane nanjaang genah nginep asrama miwah ajengan panes lianan saking makemah. La Leona, San Pedrillo, lan Los Pato wantah nanjaang makemah tanpa layanan ajengan.
eng_text: Sirena is the only ranger station that offers dormitory lodging and hot meals in addition to camping. La Leona, San Pedrillo, and Los Patos offer only camping with no food service.

text: Kaprasidayang antuk ngarereh ijin taman langsung saking stasiun ranger ring Puerto Jimenez, nanging ipun nenten nerima kartu kredit.
eng_text: It is possible to secure park permits directly from the Ranger Station in Puerto Jiménez, but they do not accept credit cards

text: Layanan taman (MINAE) nenten ngamedalang ijin taman ngalintangin asiki sasih sadurung rauhnyane.
eng_text: The Park Service (MINAE) does not issue park permits more than one month in advance of anticipated arrival.

text: CafeNet El Sol nyediayang layanan reservasi ring pangarga 30 US$, utawi 10$ antuk ngeranjing arahina; detilne wenten ring halaman Corcovado ipun.
eng_text: CafeNet El Sol offers a reservation service for a fee of US$30, or $10 for one-day passes; details on their Corcovado page.

text: Kepuloan Cook Inggih punika negara pulo sane madue hubungan bebas marep ring Selandia Baru, magenah ring Polinesia, ring tengah Segara Pasifik Kelod.
eng_text: The Cook Islands are an island country in free association with New Zealand, located in Polynesia, in the middle of the South Pacific Ocean.

text: Puniki wantah kepuloan sane madue 15 pulau sambrag ring lewih saking 2,2 yuta km2 segarane.
eng_text: It is an archipelago with 15 islands spread out over 2.2 million km2 of ocean.

text: Antuk wewidangan galah sane pateh ring Hawaii, pulo-pulo punika di sagetne kaanggap sakadi "Hawaii sane magenah ring sor".
eng_text: With the same time zone as Hawaii, the islands are sometimes thought of as "Hawaii down under".

text: Yadiastun alitan, punika ngelingang para turis lansia antuk Hawaii sadurung wenten kenegaraan tanpa sakancan hotel wisata ageng lan pengembangan lianan.
eng_text: Though smaller, it reminds some elderly visitors of Hawaii before statehood without all the large tourist hotels and other development.

text: Kepuloan Cook nenten madue kota nanging madue luir ipun 15 pulo mabinayan. Sane utama wantah Rarotonga miwah Aitutaki.
eng_text: The Cook Islands do not have any cities but are composed of 15 different islands. The main ones are Rarotonga and Aitutaki.

text: Ring negara maju galahe mangkin, nyayagayang genah sirep tur sarapan miwah sampun katincapang dados sakadi wentuk seni.
eng_text: In developed countries today, providing deluxe bed and breakfasts has been raised to a sort of art-form.

text: Ring muncuk pinih sor, B&B  wantah yakti-yakti masaing pamekas ring kalih indik utama: genah sirep lan ajengan penyemeng.
eng_text: At the top end, B&Bs obviously compete mainly on two main things: bedding and breakfast.

text: Sasampune asapunika, ring sane pinih becik kawentena sakadi punika iraga biasane nepukin genah sirep sane pinih miwah, minab saput sane kakaryanin lima utawi genah sirep antik.
eng_text: Accordingly, at the finest such establishments one is apt to find the most luxurious bedding, maybe a handmade quilt or an antique bed.

text: Ajengan penyemeng minab sampun rumasuk ajengan musiman ring wewidangane punika utawi masakan khusus tuan rumah.
eng_text: Breakfast may include seasonal delights of the region or the host's speciality dish.

text: Latar belakangne minab wantah wangunan kuna masejarah kasarengin perabot antik, halaman sane karesikang lan kolam renang.
eng_text: The setting might be an historic old building with antique furnishings, manicured grounds and a swimming pool.

text: Ngranjing ka mobil ida dane soang-soang tur ngalaksanayang pamargi sane lantang madue daya tarik intrinsik ring sadarana ipun.
eng_text: Getting into your own car and heading off on a long road trip has an intrinsic appeal in its simplicity.

text: Nenten ja sakadi wahana sane agengan, ida dane minab sampun biasa menekin mobil tur uning ring watesnyane.
eng_text: Unlike larger vehicles, you are probably already familiar with driving your car and know its limitations.

text: Nyayagayang tenda ring genah pribadi utawi ring kota lamun napi ja agengne polih elah ngarad uratian sane nenten kapikayunang.
eng_text: Setting up a tent on private property or in a town of any size can easily attract unwanted attention.

text: Cendekne, ngangge mobil ida danene wantah cara pinih becik antuk ngalaksanayang pamargi nanging kapah kaanggen pinaka cara "kemping".
eng_text: In short, using your car is a great way to take a road trip but seldom in itself a way to "camp".

text: Kemping mobil prasida kamargian yening ida dane madue minivan, SUV, sedan utawi station wagon sane madue kursi lantang.
eng_text: Car camping is possible if you have a large minivan, SUV, Sedan or Station Wagon with seats that lay down.

text: Makudang-kudang hotel madue warisan saking galah keemasan kereta api uap miwah kapal segara ageng; sadurung Perang Dunia Kaping Kalih, ring abad ka-19 utawi ka-20.
eng_text: Some hotels have a heritage from the golden age of steam railways and ocean liners; before the Second World War, in the 19th or early 20th centuries.

text: Hotel-hotel puniki magenah ring dija para warga sane sugih tur subaga rahinane punika pacang meneng, tur sesai madue ajengan luwih miwah lelanguan ring wengine.
eng_text: These hotels were where the rich and the famous of the day would stay, and often had fine dining and nightlife.

text: Instalasi sane kuna, kirangne fasilitas anyar, tur kakunaan sane janten rasmi taler dados kepahan karakter ipun.
eng_text: The old fashioned fittings, the lack of the latest amenities, and a certain graceful agedness are also part of their character.

text: Yadiastun biasane kadruenang antuk pribadi, punika di kenkene nerima rauhnyane manggala negara lan pejabat lianan.
eng_text: While they are usually privately owned, they sometimes accommodate visiting heads of state and other dignitaries.

text: Palancong sane madue jinah matumpuk minab nimbang-nimbang antuk penerbangan ka sajeroning jagad, kararianang antuk nginep ring akeh hotel puniki.
eng_text: A traveller with piles of money might consider a round the world flight, broken up with stays in many of these hotels.

text: Jaringan pertukaran perhotelan inggih punika organisasi sane ngubungang para pelancong ring warga lokal ring kota-kota sane jagi karauhin.
eng_text: A hospitality exchange network is the organization that connects travelers with locals in the cities they are going to visit.

text: Nyarengin jaringan sakadi punika katah wantah nyaratang nagingin formulir online; Yadiastun makudang jaringan nanjenang utawi nyaratang verifikasi sane kaimbuhin.
eng_text: Joining such a network usually just requires filling out an online form; although some networks offer or require additional verification.

text: Daftar tuan rumah sane sayaga salanturne kasediaang ring wentuk cetak tur/utawi online, di sagetne kasarengin referensi lan ulasan olih turis lianan.
eng_text: A listing of available hosts is then provided either in print and/or online, sometimes with references and reviews by other travelers.

text: Couchsurfing kadiriang ring Januari 2004 sasampune programer komputer Casey Fenton manggihin penerbangan mudah ka Islandia nanging nenten madue genah nginep.
eng_text: Couchsurfing was founded in January 2004 after computer programmer Casey Fenton found a cheap flight to Iceland but did not have a place to stay.

text: Ipun ngirim surel ring sisya ring universitas lokal tur nerima makudang penawaran ngangobin antuk akomodasi gratis.
eng_text: He emailed students at the local university and received an overwhelming number of offers for free accommodation.

text: Hostel ngalayanin pamekas para yowana - tamiu sane katah mayusa sawatara 20 tiban - nanging ida dane pepes manggihin palancong sane wayahan taler irika.
eng_text: Hostels cater primarily to young people – a typical guest is in their twenties – but you can often find older travellers there too.

text: Kulawarga kasarengin anak alit wantah cecingak sane kapah, nanging makudang hostel yakti ngicen ijin ipun ring kamar pribadi.
eng_text: Families with children are a rare sight, but some hostels do allow them in private rooms.

text: Kota Beijing ring Cina jagi dados tuan rumah Olimpiade Musim Dingin ring 2022, sane pacang nadosang ipun kota kapertama sane ngawentenang makakalih Olimpiade musim panes lan musim dingin.
eng_text: The city of Beijing in China will be the host city of the Olympic Winter Games in 2022, which will make it the first city to have hosted both the summer and winter Olympics.

text: Beijing pacang ngawentenang upacara pembukaan lan penutup lan acara es ring tengah ruangan.
eng_text: Beijing will host the opening and closing ceremonies and the indoor ice events.

text: Acara ski lianan pacang wenten ring wewidangan ski Taizicheng ring Zhangjiakou, sawatara 220 km (140 mil) saking Beijing.
eng_text: Other skiing events will be at the Taizicheng ski area in Zhangjiakou, about 220 km (140 miles) from Beijing.

text: Kakehan kuil madue festival nyabran warsa ngawit saking November kapuputang ring tengahing Mei, sane kabinayang manut ring kalender nyabran warsa kuil soang-soang.
eng_text: Most of the temples do have an Annual festival starting from November end to Mid of May, which varies according to each temple's annual calendar.

text: Kakehan festival kuil karayaang pinaka wagian ring wanti warsa kuil utawi ngarayaang wanti warsa dewa wiadin acara ageng lianan sane mapaiketan ring kuil punika.
eng_text: Most of the temple festivals is celebrated as part of temple's anniversary or presiding deity's birthday or any other major event associated with the temple.

text: Festival kuil Kerala wantah sane dahat menarik kasaksiang, kasarengin upakara reguler gajah mahias, orkestra kuil miwah perayaan lianan.
eng_text: Kerala's temple festivals are very interesting to see, with regular procession of decorated elephants, temple orchestra and other festivities.

text: Pameran Jagat (katah kasambat eksposisi jagat, utawi pameran kemanten) wantah festival seni lan ilmu pengetahuan internasional ageng.
eng_text: A World's Fair (commonly called World Exposition, or simply Expo) is large international festival of arts and sciences.

text: Negara-negara sane nyarengin pameran seni lan edukasi ring paviliun nasional ngedengang pikobet jagate utawi budaya miwah sejarah negaran ipune.
eng_text: Participating countries present artistic and educational displays in national pavilions to showcase world issues or their country's culture and history.

text: Eksposisi Hortikultura Internasional inggih punika acara sane ngedengang pameran bunga, kebun botani lan indik lianan sane mapaiketan ring entik-entikan.
eng_text: International Horticultural Expositions are specialised events which showcase floral displays, botanical gardens and anything else to do with plants.

text: Yadiastun antuk teori punika polih kalaksanayang nyabran warsa (selami ipun wenten ring negara sane malianan), ring praktikne punika nenten kalaksanayang.
eng_text: Although in theory they can take place annually (so long as they are in different countries), in practice they are not.

text: Acara puniki katah kalaksanayang sawatara tiga miwah nem sasih, tur kawedar ring genah sane agengnyane nenten ja alitan saking 50 hektar.
eng_text: These events normally last anywhere between three and six months, and are held on sites no smaller than 50 hectares.

text: Wenten akeh format film sane sampun kaanggen selami makudang warsa. Film standar 35 mm (ping 36 24 mm negatif) wantah sane pinih katah.
eng_text: There are many different film formats that have been used over the years. Standard 35 mm film (36 by 24 mm negative) is much the commonest.

text: Puniki biasane prasida elah kadagingin ulang yening duen ida danene telas, tur madue resolusi sane kirang langkung polih kasaihang teken DSLR sane mangkin.
eng_text: It can usually be replenished fairly easily if you run out, and gives resolution roughly comparable to a current DSLR.

text: Makudang kamera film format menengah ngangge format 6 kali 6 cm, pangidne 56 kali 56 mm negatif.
eng_text: Some medium-format film cameras use a 6 by 6 cm format, more precisely a 56 by 56 mm negative.

text: Puniki ngicen resolusi das petang kali lipat saking 35 mm negatif (3136 mm2 versus 864).
eng_text: This gives resolution almost four times that of a 35 mm negative (3136 mm2 versus 864).

text: Margasatwa wantah silih sinunggil dadalan sane pinih nantangin marep para fotografer, tur nyaratang adukan antuk aget, kesabaran, pengalaman, lan peralatan sane becik.
eng_text: Wildlife is among the most challenging motifs for a photographer, and needs a combination of good luck, patience, experience and good equipment.

text: Fotografi satwa liar pepes kasepeleang, nanging sakadi fotografi sane katah, gambar ngewakilin siuan kruna.
eng_text: Wildlife photography is often taken for granted, but like photography in general, a picture is worth a thousand words.

text: Fotografi satwa liar pepes nyaratang lensa telefoto panjang, yadiastun indik sakadi kelompok kedis utawi buron alit nyaratang lensa lianan.
eng_text: Wildlife photography often requires a long telephoto lens, though things like a flock of birds or a tiny creature need other lenses.

text: Akeh buron eksotis sane sukeh kapanggih, tur taman di ken-kene madue aturan antuk ngambil foto angge tatujon komersial.
eng_text: Many exotic animals are hard to find, and parks sometimes have rules about taking photographs for commercial purposes.

text: Buron liar minab kimud utawi agresif. Palemahane minab dingin, kebus, utawi madurgama.
eng_text: Wild animals might either be shy or aggressive. The environment might be cold, hot, or otherwise hostile.

text: Jagate madue lewih saking 5.000 basa sane mabinayan, rumasuk lebih saking duang dasa basa kaanggen olih 50 yuta pawicara.
eng_text: The world has over 5,000 different languages, including more than twenty with 50 million or more speakers.

text: Napi sane matulis pepes elahan karesepang katimbang napi sane kaucapang, taler. Puniki pamekas sujati ring indik alamat, sane pepes sukeh kaucapang antuk tatas.
eng_text: Written words are often easier to understand than spoken words, also. This is especially true of addresses, which are often difficult to pronounce intelligibly.

text: Akeh sajebag negarane lancar mabasa Inggris, tur ida dane polih ngaptiang pengetahuan mewates - pamekas ring para yowana.
eng_text: Many entire nations are completely fluent in English, and in even more you can expect a limited knowledge - especially among younger people.

text: Rawatang, yening ida dane kayun, anak saking Mancunia, Boston, Jamaika, pinggiran Sidney malinggih ring meja ngajeng ring wengine ring restoran Toronto.
eng_text: Imagine, if you will, a Mancunian, Bostonian, Jamaican and Sydneysider sitting around a table having dinner at a restaurant in Toronto.

text: Ipun saling ngargain ngangge satua-satua saking kampung halaman ipun, nyaritayang ngangge aksen ipun sane mabinayan lan dialek lokal.
eng_text: They're regaling each other with stories from their hometowns, told in their distinct accents and local argot.

text: Numbas ajengan ring supermarket biasane cara pinih mudah antuk ngarereh ajengan. Tanpa galah malebengan, pilihan kawatesin ring ajengan sane sayaga antuk kalebengin.
eng_text: Buying food in supermarkets is usually the cheapest way to get fed. Without cooking opportunities, choices are however limited to ready-made food.

text: Ngakehang supermarket ngayagayang mabinayan wewidangan antuk ajengan siap masak. Makudang-kudangnyane taler nyayagayang oven microwave utawi cara lianan antuk manesin ajengan.
eng_text: Increasingly supermarkets are getting a more varied section of ready-made food. Some even provide a microwave oven or other means to heat food.

text: Ring makudang negara utawi soroh toko, sakirangne wenten asiki restoran antuk ngajeng ring genahnyane, sesaine marupa restoran sedeng informal kasarengin pangarga sane polih mudah.
eng_text: In some countries or types of stores there is at least one on-site restaurant, often a rather informal one with affordable prices.

text: Karyanin tur bakta salinan kebijakan ida danene miwah detail kontak perusahaan asuransi ida danene.
eng_text: Make and carry copies of your policy and your insurer's contact details with you.

text: Punika sarat ngedengang alamat email perusahaan asuransi lan nomer telepon internasional antuk piteket/otorisasi lan ngaryanang klaim.
eng_text: They need to show the insurer's e-mail address and international phone numbers for advice/authorizations and making claims.

text: Duenang salinan lianan ring bagasi ida danene tur online (kirim email ka ragan ida danene ngangge lampiran, utawi simpen ring "Cloud").
eng_text: Have another copy in your luggage and online (e-mail to yourself with attachment, or stored in the "cloud").

text: Yening malelungan makta laptop utawi tablet, simpen salinan ring memori utawi disk (polih kaakses tanpa internet).
eng_text: If traveling with a laptop or tablet, store a copy in its memory or disc (accessible without the internet).

text: Taler icen salinan kebijakan / kontak ring sawitra utawi semeton utawi sawitra sapamargi utawi sawitra ring jumah sane prasida ngawantu.
eng_text: Also give policy/contact copies to traveling companions and relatives or friends back home willing to help.

text: Moose (taler kasambat dados elk) antuk inheren wantah nenten agresif, nanging pacang ngabihin ragan ipun yening ipun nemu ancaman.
eng_text: Moose (also known as elk) aren't inherently aggressive, but will defend themselves if they perceive a threat.

text: Yening manusa nenten nganggap moose sakadi madue potensi baya, ipun minab maekin kaliwat nampek tur ngenahang ragan ipun ring resiko.
eng_text: When people don't see moose as potentially dangerous, they may approach too closely and put themselves at risk.

text: Nginum minuman maalkohol antuk sedeng. Alkohol mlalahin makasami manusa mabinayan, tur rarisne nguningin antuk wates ida danene wantah dahat mabuat.
eng_text: Drink alcoholic drinks with moderation. Alcohol affects everyone differently, and knowing your limit is very important.

text: Peristiwa kesehatan sane minab wenten ring galah sane panjang mawinan nginum lebihan wantah kausakan hati miwah taler kebutaan lan kematian. Potensi baya ipun nincap rikala nginum alkohol sane kaproduksi ilegal.
eng_text: Possible long term health events from excessive drinking can include liver damage and even blindness and death. The potential danger is increased when consuming illegally produced alcohol.

text: Minuman malkohol ilegal polih madaging magenepan kaletehan madurgama minakadi methanol, sane polih ngranayang kebutaan utawi kematian yadiastun ring dosis akidik.
eng_text: Illegal spirits can contain various dangerous impurities including methanol, which can cause blindness or death even in small doses.

text: Kacamata polih mudahan ring negara asing, pamekas ring negara-negara madue pendapatan andap ring dija tenaga kerja wantah mudahan.
eng_text: Eyeglasses can be cheaper in a foreign country, especially in low-income countries where labour costs are lower.

text: Timbang antuk ngarereh panureksan penyingakan ring jumah, pamekas yening wenten asuransi sane naurin, tur makta resep antuk kaajuang ring genah lianan.
eng_text: Consider getting an eye exam at home, especially if insurance covers it, and bringing the prescription along to be filed elsewhere.

text: Bingkai mamerek kelas atas wenten ring wewidangan sakadi punika minab madue kalih pikobet; makudangnyane minab tiruan, tur sane asli kaimpor minab maelan katimbang jumah.
eng_text: High-end brand-name frames available in such areas may have two problems; some may be knock-offs, and the real imported ones may be more expensive than at home.

text: Kopi wantah silih sinunggil komoditas sane pinih akeh kaadolang ring jagate, tur ida dane minab polih nemuang akeh jenisnyane ring genah asal ida danene.
eng_text: Coffee is one of the world's most traded commodities, and you can probably find many types in your home region.

text: Nanging kenten, wenten akeh cara khas nginum kopi ring sajeroning jagat sane patut kacuba.
eng_text: Nevertheless, there are many distinctive ways of drinking coffee around the world that are worth experiencing.

text: Canyoning (utawi: canyoneering) wantah indik malelungan ring sor ngarai, sane polih tuh utawi bek madaging toya.
eng_text: Canyoning (or: canyoneering) is about going in a bottom of a canyon, which is either dry or full of water.

text: Canyoning ngadukang elemen-elemen sakadi ngelangi, ngodkod tur makecog - nanging nyaratang akidik latihan utawi wentuk fisik mangdane polih kalaksanayang (katimbang manjat tebing, menyelam, utawi ski alpen, misalne).
eng_text: Canyoning combines elements from swimming, climbing and jumping--but requires relatively little training or physical shape to get started (compared to rock climbing, scuba diving or alpine skiing, for example).

text: Mendaki wantah aktivitas ring palemahan sane nyakup mamargi ring palemahan alami, pepesne ring jalur mendaki.
eng_text: Hiking is an outdoor activity which consists of walking in natural environments, often on hiking trails.

text: Mendaki ngalibatang jarak kirang ring asiki mil ngantos jarak sane dohan tur polih katempuh ring galah arahina.
eng_text: Day hiking involves distances of less than a mile up to longer distances that can be covered in a single day.

text: Antuk mendaki arahina ngalintangin jalur sane elah akidik persiapan kasaratang, tur anak sane sedeng kenak polih ngalaksanayang punika.
eng_text: For a day hike along an easy trail little preparations are needed, and any moderately fit person can enjoy them.

text: Kulawarga sane madue anak alit minab nyaratang persiapan lebihan, nanging wenten ring palemahan arahina tuah kaprasidayang yadiastun wenten bayi utawi balita.
eng_text: Families with small children may need more preparations, but a day outdoors is easily possible even with babies and pre-school children.

text: Antuk internasional, wenten sawatara 200 organisasi tur malaib. Kakehan ring ipun maoperasi antuk bebas.
eng_text: Internationally, there are nearly 200 running tour organizations. Most of them operate independently.

text: Penerus Global Running Tour, Go Running Tours ngubungang lusinan penyedia sightrunning ring papat benua.
eng_text: The Global Running Tours successor, Go Running Tours networks dozens of sightrunning providers on four continents.

text: Madue wit ring Running Tours Barcelona ring Barcelona miwah Running Copenhagen ring Copenhagen, wantah gelis kasarengin olih Running Tours Prague sane wenten ring Praha miwah sane lianan.
eng_text: With roots in Barcelona's Running Tours Barcelona and Copenhagen's Running Copenhagen, it was quickly joined by Running Tours Prague based in Prague and others.

text: Wenten akeh sane patut ida dane timbang sadurungne tur rikala ida dane malalungan ka genah sane janten.
eng_text: There are many things you have to take into consideration before and when you travel somewhere.

text: Rikala ida dane malelungan, aptiang sakancan parindikan nenten sakadi ipun "ring jumah". Tata krama, hukum, ajengan, lalu lintas, penginapan, standar, basa, muah sane lianan makudang-kudangnyane jagi malianan saking genah ida dane meneng.
eng_text: When you travel, expect things not to be like they are "back home". Manners, laws, food, traffic, lodging, standards, language and so on will to some extent differ from where you live.

text: Puniki wantah napi sane sesai patut ida dane elingang, mantuka ring ngimpasin kuciwa utawi nenten seneng ring cara-cara lokal antuk ngalaksanayang indik napi ja.
eng_text: This is something you always need to keep in mind, to avoid disappointment or perhaps even distaste over local ways to do things.

text: Agen pamargi sampun wenten sekat abad ke-19. Agen pamargi katahnyane wantah pilihan sane becik antuk pamargi sane nyakup ngalintangin pengalaman wisatawan sadurungne ring indik palemahan, budaya, basa, utawi negara sane madue alih-alihan akidik.
eng_text: Travel agencies have been around since the 19th century. A travel agent is usually a good option for a journey which extends beyond a traveller's previous experience of nature, culture, language or low-income countries.

text: Yadiastun kakehan lembaga kayun ngambil kakehan pemesanan reguler, akeh agen wantah kajantenang antuk soroh pamargine, embang anggaran, utawi tetujon.
eng_text: Although most agencies are willing to take on most regular bookings, many agents specialise in particular types of travel, budget ranges or destinations.

text: Becikan ngangge agen sane pepes mesen pamargi sane mirip ring pemargin ida danene.
eng_text: It can be better to use an agent who frequently books similar trips to yours.

text: Cingakin napi sane kapromosiang olih agen, ring situs web utawi ring jendela tokone.
eng_text: Take a look at what trips the agent is promoting, whether on a website or in a shop window.

text: Yening ida dane kayun nyingakin jagate antuk pangarga mudah, duaning kebutuhan, gaya hidup utawi tantangan, wenten makudang cara antuk ngelaksanayang punika.
eng_text: If you want to see the world on the cheap, for necessity, lifestyle or challenge, there are some ways to do that.

text: Pada dasarne, ipun kepah dados kalih soroh: mawiguna rikala ida dane malelungan utawi mautsaha tur ngawatesin pengeluaran ida danene. Artikel puniki kauntengang ring sane kaping untat.
eng_text: Basically, they fall into two categories: Either work while you travel or try and limit your expenses. This article is focused on the latter.

text: Ring ipun sane masedia ngorbanang kenyamanan, galah, utawi prediktibilitas antuk neken bea ka sor nuju nol, rereh pemargi maanggaran minimum.
eng_text: For those willing to sacrifice comfort, time and predictability to push expenses down close to zero, see minimum budget travel.

text: Piteket punika nyatmakayang turis nenten ngamaling, ngranjing tanpa ijin, nyarengin pasar ilegal, magegendong, utawi manfaatang anak lianan antuk keuntungan ipun padidi.
eng_text: The advice assumes that travellers do not steal, trespass, participate in the illegal market, beg, or otherwise exploit other people for their own gain.

text: Pos panureksan imigrasi katahnyane wantah genah mareren kapertama rikala tuun saking pesawat, kapal, utawi kendaraan lianan.
eng_text: An immigration checkpoint is usually the first stop when disembarking from a plane, a ship, or another vehicle.

text: Ring makudang inspeksi kereta lintas wates kalaksanayang rikala kereta mamargi tur ida dane patut madue identitas sane berlaku risedek menekin silih sinunggil keretane punika.
eng_text: In some cross-border trains inspections are done on the running train and you should have valid ID with you when boarding one of those trains.

text: Ring kereta sirep wengine, paspor polih kapunduhang olih konduktur dadosne sirep ida danene nenten kausik.
eng_text: On night sleeper trains, passports may be collected by the conductor so that you do not have your sleep interrupted.

text: Pendaftaran wantah prasyarat imbuhan antuk proses visa. Ring makudang negara, ida dane patut naftarang kawentenan tur alamat ring dija ida dane meneng marep pemerintah setempat.
eng_text: Registration is an additional requirement for the visa process. In some countries, you must register your presence and address where you are staying with the local authorities.

text: Puniki minab nyaratang nagingin formulir ring polisi lokal utawi ngarauhin kantor imigrasi.
eng_text: This might require filling out a form with the local police or a visit to the immigration offices.

text: Ring akeh negara sane madue hukum sakadi punika, hotel-hotel lokal pacang nanganin pendaftaran (elingang antuk mataken).
eng_text: In many countries with such a law, local hotels will handle the registration (make sure to ask).

text: Ring kasus lianan, tuah ipun sane meneng ring salianan saking akomodasi wisata sane kasaratang mendaftar. Nanging puniki ngranayang hukume dados kirang tatas, kerana punika rereh informasi sadurungne.
eng_text: In other cases, only those staying outside of tourist accommodations need to register.  However, this makes the law much more obscure, so find out beforehand.

text: Arsitektur mapaiketan ring desain miwah konstruksi wangunan. Arsitektur genah pepes wantah obyek wisata punika padidi.
eng_text: Architecture is concerned with the design and construction of buildings. The architecture of a place is often a tourist attraction in its own right.

text: Akeh wangunan sedeng rasmi antuk kacingak tur cecingak saking wangunan tegeh utawi saking jendela sane kagenahang becik polih dados rasmi kacingak.
eng_text: Many buildings are quite beautiful to look at and the view from a tall building or from a cleverly-positioned window can be a beauty to behold.

text: Arsitektur tumpang tindih ring widang sane lianan minakadi pangrencana kota, teknik sipil, seni dekoratif, desain interior, miwah desain lanskap.
eng_text: Architecture overlaps considerably with other fields including urban planning, civil engineering, decorative arts, interior design and landscape design.

text: Eling ring dohnyane kakehan kampung Indian, ida dane nenten prasida nemonin kaidupan wengi tanpa malelungan ka Albuquerque utawi Santa Fe.
eng_text: Given how remote many of the pueblos are, you won't be able to find a significant amount of nightlife without traveling to Albuquerque or Santa Fe.

text: Nanging, das makasami kasino sane kasurat baduur nyajiang minuman, tur makudang pacang makta hiburan mamerk (pamekas sane ageng pragata ngalilingin Albuquerque miwah Santa Fe).
eng_text: However, nearly all of the casinos listed above serve drinks, and several of them bring in name-brand entertainment (primarily the large ones immediately surrounding Albuquerque and Santa Fe).

text: Tragia: Bar kota alit iriki nenten sesai wantah genah sane becik antuk pengunjung luar negeri malali.
eng_text: Beware: small-town bars here are not always good places for the out-of-state visitor to hang out.

text: Antuk asiki parindikan, New Mexico Kaja madue pikobet sane mabuat antuk nyetir rikala punyah, tur angka supir sane punyah wantah tegeh nampek ring bar-bar kota sane alit.
eng_text: For one thing, northern New Mexico has significant problems with drunk driving, and the concentration of intoxicated drivers is high close to small-town bars.

text: Mural utawi coretan sane nenten kapikayunin kasambat dados grafiti.
eng_text: Unwanted murals or scribble is known as graffiti.

text: Risedek punika doh saking fenomena modern, kakehan anak mirib ngaitang ring anak muda ngusak properti umum tur pribadi ngangge cat semprot.
eng_text: While it's far from a modern phenomenon, most people probably associate it with youth vandalizing public and private property using spray paint.

text: Nanging, ring galahe mangkin wenten seniman grafiti, acara grafiti miwah tembok "legal". Lukisan grafiti ring paiketan puniki pepes dados karya seni nenten ja tuah sasuratan sane ten polih kawacen.
eng_text: However, nowadays there are established graffiti artists, graffiti events and "legal" walls. Graffiti paintings in this context often resemble artworks rather than illegible tags.

text: Ngentungang bumerang wantah kewagedan populer sane kayun kakuasain olih akeh wisatawan.
eng_text: Boomerang throwing is a popular skill that many tourists want to acquire.

text: Yening ida dane mapikayun malajah ngentungang bumerang sane mewali ka tangan ida dane, pastikayang ida dane madue bumerang sane pangid antuk kawaliang.
eng_text: If you want to learn throwing a boomerang that comes back to your hand, make sure you have a suitable boomerang for returning.

text: Kakehan bumerang sane wenten ring Australia sujatine nenten polih mawali. Becik antuk pemula nenten nyoba ngentungang bumerang ri kala wenten angin.
eng_text: Most boomerangs available in Australia are in fact non-returning. It is best for beginners to not try throwing in windy

text: Ajengan Hangi kalebengin ring bolong ring tanahe.
eng_text: A Hangi Meal is cooked in a hot pit in the ground.

text: Bolong punika kapanesin ngangge watu-watu kebus kerana api, utawi ring makudang wewidangan panes saking panas bumi ngranayang wewidangan ring tanah punika kebus alami.
eng_text: The pit is either heated with hot stones from a fire, or in some places geothermal heat makes areas of ground naturally hot.

text: Hangi pepes kaanggen antuk ngalebengin ajengan wengi gaya panggang tradisional.
eng_text: The hangi is often used to cook a traditional roast style dinner.

text: Makudang genah ring Rotorua nanjaang hangi panas bumi, risedek hangi antuk lianan polih kaambil contone ring Christchurch, Wellington miwah ring genah lianan.
eng_text: Several places in Rotorua offer geothermal hangi, while other hangi can be sampled in Christchurch, Wellington and elsewhere.

text: MetroRail madue kalih kelas ring kereta komuter ring tur nampek ring Cape Town: MetroPlus (taler kasambat Kelas Pertama) miwah Metro (kasambat Kelas Kaping Tiga).
eng_text: MetroRail has two classes on commuter trains in and around Cape Town: MetroPlus (also called First Class) and Metro (called Third Class).

text: MetroPlus wantah lebih nyaman tur kirang rame nanging akidik maelan, yadiastun kantun mudahan katimbang tiket metro normal ring Eropa.
eng_text: MetroPlus is more comfortable and less crowded but slightly more expensive, though still cheaper than normal metro tickets in Europe.

text: Sabilang kereta madue gerbong MetroPlus miwah Metro; Gerbong MetroPlus setata wenten ring muncuk kereta pinih nampek ring Cape Town.
eng_text: Every train has both MetroPlus and Metro coaches; the MetroPlus coaches are always on the end of the train nearest Cape Town.

text: Makta sane lianan - Sampunang ngicen tas ida danene nenten kacingak, pamekas yening ida dane ngaliwatin perwatesan internasional.

eng_text: As with respiratory problems in colder climates, intestinal problems in hot climates are fairly common and in most cases are distinctly annoying but not really dangerous.

eng_text: If traveling in a developing country for the first time – or in a new part of the world – don't underestimate the potential culture shock.

eng_text: Especially in your initial days, consider splurging on Western-style and -quality hotels, food, and services to help acclimatize.

eng_text: Do not sleep on a mattress or pad on the ground in areas where you do not know the local fauna.

eng_text: Fill your home with a rich coffee in the morning and some relaxing chamomile tea at night.

eng_text: When you're on a staycation, you have the time to treat yourself and take a few extra minutes to brew up something special.

eng_text: If you're feeling more adventurous, take the opportunity to juice or blend up some smoothies:

eng_text: maybe you'll discover a simple beverage that you can make for breakfast when you're back to your daily routine.

text: Yéning ida dané meneng ring kota sané akéh antuk minuman-minuman, sampunang lali rauh ka bar-bar ring wawidangan sané ida dané kapah rauhin.
eng_text: If you live in a city with a varied drinking culture, go to bars or pubs in neighborhoods you don't frequent.

text: Buat anak sané tan biasa antuk kruna-kruna medis, kruna inféksi miwah nglahlah madaging arti sané lénan.
eng_text: For those unfamiliar with medical jargon, the words infectious and contagious have distinct meanings.

text: Pinyungkan inféksi inggih punika pinyungkan sané mawinan antuk patogén, minakadi virus, baktéri, jamur miwah parasit sané tiosan.
eng_text: An infectious disease is one that is caused by a pathogen, such as a virus, bacterium, fungus or other parasites.

text: Pinyungkan sané nglahlah punika pinyungkan sané kalahlahin sawiréh meneng ring genah sané sampun inféksi grubug.
eng_text: A contagious disease is a disease which is easily transmitted by being in the vicinity of an infected person.

text: Akéh wénten pameréntah sané ngarsayang wisatawan sané rauh, utawi kramané sané pacang luas ring dura negara, mangda satata mapaksin antuk panyakit sané tiosan puniki.
eng_text: Many governments require visitors entering, or residents leaving, their countries to be vaccinated for a range of diseases.

eng_text: These requirements may often depend on what countries a traveller has visited or intends to visit.

text: Parindikan sané paling kuat ring Charlotte, North Carolina asapunika wénten limbak sané akéh tur luwih pisan kaatur ring kulawarga.
eng_text: One of strong points of Charlotte, North Carolina, is that it has an abundance of high-quality options for families.

text: Palemahan sané gumanti tur ajer ring kulawarga dados dadalan krama-krama sané rauh uli wawidangan sané lénan. Tamiu-tamiu punika ngrasayang kota punika gampang tur kasenengin olih alit-alit ring soang-soang.
eng_text: Residents from other areas often cite family-friendliness as a primary reason for moving there, and visitors often find the city easy to enjoy with children around.

text: Ring 20 warsa puniki, parindikan kota sané luwih anggén genah alit-alite mangkin sampun akéh ring Uptown Charlotte.
eng_text: In the past 20 years, the amount of child-friendly options in Uptown Charlotte has grown exponentially.

text: Ring Charlotte, taksi nénten lumrah kaanggén, yadiapin taksi punika patut kaanggén antuk kaperluan-kaperluan sané tiosan.
eng_text: Taxis are not generally used by families in Charlotte, though they can be of some use in certain circumstances.

eng_text: There is a surcharge for having more than 2 passengers, so this option might be more expensive than necessary.

text: Antartika wantah genah pinih dingin ring gumi, tur ngiterin Kutub Kelod.
eng_text: Antarctica is the coldest place on Earth, and surrounds the South Pole.

text: Kujungan turis maal, nuntut raga sané siteng, tuah polih kalanturin ring masan panes Nov-Feb, miwah kakéhan kawates ring Semenanjung, Kepuloan, lan Segara Ross.
eng_text: Tourist visits are costly, demand physical fitness, can only take place in summer Nov-Feb, and are largely limited to the Peninsula, Islands and Ross Sea.

text: Makudang-kudang tali staf meneng driki ring masan panes ring sawatara papat lusin pangkalan kaakéhan ring wewidangan punika; akidik meneng salami masan dingin.
eng_text: A couple of thousand staff live here in summer in some four dozen bases mostly in those areas; a small number stay over winter.

eng_text: Inland Antarctica is a desolate plateau covered by 2-3 km of ice.

text: Tur udara spesial sapisan mendarat, antuk menekin gunung utawi antuk nincapang Kutub, sané madue landasan ageng.
eng_text: Occasional specialist air tours go inland, for mountaineering or to reach the Pole, which has a large base.

text: Wawidangan kelod utawi Sentinel Range inggih punika wawidangan sané kasarengin antuk pegunungan sané pinih tegeh ring Antartika, Massif Vinson, puncak ipun kagenahan antuk Gunung Vinson sané tegeh ipun nganti 4892 méter.
eng_text: The South Pole Traverse (or Highway) is a 1600 km trail from McMurdo Station on the Ross Sea to the Pole.

text: Marga punika katutupin antuk salju sareng selagan-selagan sané sampun madaging lelonték. Marga puniki wantah dados kaliwatin olih traktor sané spésial, ngajang kréta sané makta bahan bakar miwah kaperluan.
eng_text: It's compacted snow with crevasses filled in and marked by flags. It can only be traveled by specialized tractors, hauling sleds with fuel and supplies.

text: Piranti puniki nénten je gelis pisan. Punika mawinan kawéntenang marga punika joh uli Transantarctic Mountains nuju ka dataran sané tegeh.
eng_text: These aren't very nimble so the trail has to take a long swerve around the Transantarctic Mountains to come onto the plateau.

text: Sané pinih lumrah ngranayang kecelakaan ring musim dingin inggih punika marga, trotoar (sisin margi), miwah pamekas undag sané belig.
eng_text: The most common cause for accidents in winter is slippery roads, pavements (sidewalks) and especially steps.

text: Pinih rihin, ida dané patut makta sepatu sané mesol tebel. Sepatu sané kaanggén ring musim panas biasané dahat belig ring és miwah salju, kadi rasa sepatu musim dingin sané mawasta sepatu but punika masih kuangan yéning kaanggén ring musimé punika.
eng_text: At a minimum, you need footwear with suitable soles. Summer shoes are usually very slippery on ice and snow, even some winter boots are deficient.

text: Patutne polane cukup dalem, kirang langkung 5 mm (1/5 inci) utawi lebih, taler ngange bahan sane alusan ring wewidangan masuhu dingin.
eng_text: The pattern should be deep enough, 5 mm (1/5 inch) or more, and the material soft enough in cold temperatures.

text: Sampun wénten makudang-kudang sepatu but sané beténné magigi anggén majalan ring margi sané belig, cocok kaanggén ring sepatu biasa utawi sepatu but, miwah ring sandal tinjik utawi sané nganggén ganjotan.
eng_text: Some boots have studs and there is studded add-on equipment for slippery conditions, suitable for most shoes and boots, for the heels or heels and sole.

text: Ganjotan sepatu punika musti endek tur gedé, sawiréh buk, batu-batu, miwah garam (kalsium klorida) akéh nglimbak ring margané anggén nincapang tenaga tarik.
eng_text: Heels should be low and wide. Sand, gravel or salt (calcium chloride) is often scattered on roads or paths to improve traction.

text: Kawéntenan tanah longsor inggih punika lumrah; léréng sané dalem irika lambat anggén nampung tanah sané embid, taler embidan tanah punika ngaliunan longsor tur anyut.
eng_text: Avalanches are not an abnormality; steep slopes can hold only so much slow, and the excess volumes will come down as avalanches.

text: Salju sané jagi neket punika dados masalah, punika mawinan saljuné musti kauyeg apang sinah ulung, taler makudang-kudang salju sané ulung utawi sabeh punika magentos peristiwa pamicu ring masalah sané lianan.
eng_text: The problem is that snow is sticky, so it needs some triggering to come down, and some snow coming down can be the triggering event for the rest.

text: Peristiwa pamicu punika kaget sangkaning matan ai sané manesin salju, kawéntenan salju sané ngakéhang, kawéntenan peristiwa-peristiwa alam sané tiosan, miwah ulah manusa sinamian.
eng_text: Sometimes the original trigging event is the sun warming the snow, sometimes some more snowfall, sometimes other natural events, often a human.

text: Tornado inggih punika angin kenceng sané mapiteh nganggén tekanan alit miwah ngisep angin ring genah ipun menék lan tuun.
eng_text: A tornado is a spinning column of very low-pressure air, which sucks the surrounding air inward and upward.

text: Anginné punika ngasilin angin kenceng (kirang langkung 100-200 mil / jam) taler prasida ngancit objék-objék sané baat tur makta objék punika pinaka gerak tornado.
eng_text: They generate high winds (often 100-200 miles/hour) and can lift heavy objects into the air, carrying them as the tornado moves.

text: Gerak-gerak angin punika ngawit antuk sakadi corong saking bakungan awan gedé miwah dados "tornado" yéning sampun neked ring tanah.
eng_text: They begin as funnels descending from storm clouds, and become "tornadoes" when they touch the ground.

text: Layanan VPN (Virtual Private Network) pribadi inggih punika becik anggén ngelidin sensor politik miwah IP-geofiltering sané komersial.
eng_text: Personal VPN (virtual private network) providers are an excellent way of circumventing both political censorship and commercial IP-geofiltering.

text: Layanan-layanan punika sampun unggul ring web proxy sangkaning makudang-kudang gegunan: layanan-layanan punika prasida ngulang makejang aktivitas sané kalaksanayang ring internét, tusing http dogén.
eng_text: They are superior to web proxies for several reasons: They re-route all Internet traffic, not only http.

eng_text: They normally offer higher bandwidth and better quality of service. They are encrypted and thus harder to spy on.

text: Pamilet média ring bidang puniki sampun sesai mogbogin masyarakat ulian tetujon punika, ngaku layanan punika patut anggén "nambakin sajeroning pembajak ring internét".
eng_text: The media companies routinely lie about the purpose of this, claiming that it is to "prevent piracy".

text: Sujatiné, kode wilayah nénten wénten dampak ring penyalinan ilégal; penyalinan kidik akidik sujatinyané dados majalan lancar ring piranti sinamian, pamekas genah sané asli.
eng_text: In fact, region codes have absolutely no effect on illegal copying; a bit-for-bit copy of a disk will play just fine on any device where the original will.

eng_text: The actual purpose is to give those companies more control over their markets; it's all about money spinning.

text: Duaning panggilan sampun pindah nganggén internét, ida dané ten perlu nganggén télpun perusahaan sané magenah ring wawidangan utawi wawidangan sané karauhin soang-soang .
eng_text: Because calls are routed over the Internet, you do not need to use a phone company located where you live or where you travel.

text: Wénten taler persyaratan antuk polih nomor lokal saking pakraman ida dané meneng; ida dané dados polih sinyal internét satelit ring Alaska, miwah milih nomor sané nunjukkang ida dané sedek nongos ring Arizona.
eng_text: There is also no requirement that you obtain a local number from the community in which you live; you can obtain a satellite Internet connection in the wilds of Chicken, Alaska and select a number which claims you're in sunny Arizona.

text: Ida dané patut numbas nomor global sané mapisah tur mrasidayang télpun PSTN anggén nélpun ragané. Lokasi ngawitin nomor punika ngicénin indik pabinaan ring penelpun ida dané.
eng_text: Often, you have to buy a global number separately that allows PSTN phones to call you. Where the number is from makes a difference for people calling you.

text: Aplikasi penerjemah téks inggih punika aplikasi sané mrasidayang ida dané otomatis ngartiang parindikan téks uli basa abesik ka basa sané lianan.
eng_text: Real-time text translator apps – applications that are capable of automatically translating whole segments of text from one language into another.

text: Makudang-kudang aplikasi puniki taler prasida ngartiang téks ring basa asing sakadi objék-objék miwah tanda sané karekam utawi katunjuk langsung olih piranti télpun druéné.
eng_text: Some of the applications in this category can even translate texts in foreign languages on signs or other objects in the real world when the user points the smartphone towards those objects.

text: Piranti penerjemah punika sampun lédang nincapang miwah mangkin sampun prasida ngartiang kruna saha melah, nanging kari perlu perbaikan, sawiréh asil terjemahan ipun kaget wénten masih iwang.
eng_text: The translation engines have improved dramatically, and now often give more or less correct translations (and more seldom gibberish), but some care is due, as they still may have gotten it all wrong.

text: Silih tunggil aplikasi sané kasub ring kategori puniki inggih punika Google Translate, sané lédang mrasidayang ida dané makarya terjemahan tanpa onlain sesudan ida dané ngunduh berkas basa sané kayunin.
eng_text: One of the most prominent apps in this category is Google Translate, which allows offline translation after downloading the desired language data.

text: Nganggén aplikasi GPS sané kapasang ring télpun ida dané sinah aluh mrasidayang ngawacakang lokasi yéning ida dané luas ka dura negara.
eng_text: Using GPS navigation apps on your smartphone can be the easiest and most convenient way to navigate when out of your home country.

text: Yéning nganggén aplikasi punika, anggarané prasida inih malih kidik krana tusing perlu numbasin péta asli utawi ida dané dados masang piranti GPS mandiri utawi nyéwa asiki ring perusahaan layanan montor.
eng_text: It can save money over buying new maps for a GPS, or a standalone GPS device or renting one from a car rental company.

text: Yéning ida dané ten madué data internét ring télpun druéné, utawi yéning sedek ring wawidangan sané ten madué sinyal, layanan piranti punika pacang ngenduk miwah ten setata sedia ring wawidangan punika.
eng_text: If you don't have a data connection for your phone, or when it is out of range, their performance can be limited or unavailable.

text: Sabilang bucu medaging antuk kartu télpun liu masusun tur mecampur sané dumun mekanggo ring télpun umum miwah anggén télpun sané biasa.
eng_text: Every corner store is filled with a confusing array of pre-paid phone cards that can be used from pay phones or ordinary telephones.

text: Duaning liunan kartu sané dados anggén ring dija-dija, wénten masih kartu-kartu sané mrasidayang prabéa kusus ring kelompok negara-negara sané masikian.
eng_text: While most cards are good for calling anywhere, some specialise in providing favourable call rates to specific groups of countries.

text: Aksés tur layanan ring nomor télpun sané bébas pulsa punika dados télpun uli akéh jenis télpun tanpa keni béa.
eng_text: Access to these services is often through a toll-free telephone number that can be called from most phones without charge.

text: Yéning ida dané motrék objék sané ten patut, rarisan adungang iraga mangda ten ngrekam pidio ring wawidangan punika.
eng_text: If just taking a photo of something isn't allowed, then you shouldn't even think of recording a video of it.

text: Yéning ida dané nganggén dron, ledang cek dumun parindikan objék-objék sané polih ijin anggén ngerekam tur yéning wénten ijin lianan sané patut kaatur.
eng_text: If using a drone, check well in advance as to what you are allowed to film and what permits or additional licensing are required.

text: Ngelebang dron ring bandara utawi baduur anaké sané akéh maruyuan inggih punika laksana sané ten patut, yadiapin parindikan laksana punika tusing je ilégal ring genah soang-soang.
